# Southern Maryland Community Forums

> A vibrant community forum for Southern Maryland residents to discuss local news, share opportunities, and connect with neighbors.

Southern Maryland Community Forums is the primary hub for local discussion, classifieds, and community engagement in the Southern Maryland region. The platform hosts job listings, real estate opportunities, media galleries, and active community discussion threads.

## Key Topics

- Southern Maryland
- Community Forums
- Local Discussion
- Job Listings
- Real Estate
- Media Gallery
- Activity Feed
- Resources
- Public Service Announcements
- Community Members
- Latest Threads
- Local News
- Volunteer Opportunities
- Classifieds

## Activity & Discovery

- [Latest Activity](https://forums.somd.com/whats-new/latest-activity): Real-time activity stream of all community forum events
- [New Posts](https://forums.somd.com/whats-new/posts): Feed of latest posts across Southern Maryland Community Forums
- [New Media](https://forums.somd.com/whats-new/media): Gallery feed of newly uploaded media in community forums
- [New Resources](https://forums.somd.com/whats-new/resources): Feed of latest shared resources in community forums
- [New Media Comments](https://forums.somd.com/whats-new/media-comments): Activity feed for new comments on community media uploads

## Classifieds & Opportunities

- [Job Listings](https://forums.somd.com/pages/so-md-job-listings): Job listings and employment classifieds for Southern Maryland
- [Real Estate Listings](https://forums.somd.com/pages/so-md-real-estate-listings): Real estate listings and rental properties in Southern Maryland

## Main Discussion Forums

- [Life in Southern Maryland](https://forums.somd.com/forums/life-in-southern-maryland.8): Main discussion forum for Southern Maryland living and local news
- [Public Service Announcements](https://forums.somd.com/forums/public-service-announcements.214): Forum for community announcements and volunteer opportunities

## Media & Resources

- [Media Gallery](https://forums.somd.com/media): Community photo gallery and media sharing hub
- [Resources](https://forums.somd.com/resources): Shared resources, downloads, and wallpapers directory
- [Latest Reviews](https://forums.somd.com/resources/latest-reviews): Feed of latest community reviews on shared resources

## Community & Members

- [Notable Members](https://forums.somd.com/members): Directory of most active members with rankings and profiles
- [Current Visitors](https://forums.somd.com/online): Real-time tracker of currently online community members

## Optional

- [Daily Chat Thread (3/21/26)](https://forums.somd.com/threads/3-21-26.417343/post-6745996): Daily community chat thread about weather and local activities
